subject: Agile Modeling status: end-to-end flow live, alpha metric needed
body:
Hi Dmitri, Alina,

Status. The end-to-end flow works on the internal mirror: concept in, a few labeling rounds, working classifier out — about 20 minutes wall-clock for our test users, which matches the concept-to-classifier-in-minutes pitch. The 14-concept user-labeled data is mirrored and is now our regression eval; we track mean AP across concepts.

Risk for the OKR lock on 2026-06-26: we need to commit to an alpha metric now. I propose mean AP >= 0.75 across the 14 concepts plus time-to-first-classifier under 30 minutes. If we don't lock a number this week we'll get one assigned to us.

Vera
